title: Family Handbook, School Nutrition Section: Active, Inactive and Reactivated Meal Accounts and the Account Campus
content:
- Meals and items are rung up on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account only when the account is in status active.
- The account becomes inactive on the last day of attendance when the student withdraws from the district or graduates, and its balance stays on the account.
- An inactive account is reactivated only when the student again holds a district enrollment record in status provisional or enrolled, and the account's campus becomes the campus of that enrollment. The enrollment record's status decides this, not the household's statement that the student is returning.
- When the student's enrollment changes campus, the account's campus follows from the same date, which changes the campus pricing level and the CEP override from that date.
- A new account opens on Paid Meal Status unless a determination of the household already reaches the student under the household-reach rules for meal status.

## Status table

| Account status | Purchases rung up | How it changes |
|---|---|---|
| active | yes | becomes inactive on the last day of attendance at withdrawal or graduation |
| inactive | no | reactivated when the student's enrollment record is provisional or enrolled |
| closed | no | never reopened |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A student moves mid-year from Alder Springs Elementary to Cypress Hollow Elementary. From the date of the move the account's campus is Cypress Hollow Elementary, a CEP campus, so reimbursable meals rung up from that date carry the CEP meal charge.
